newsitem.title: BRAZIL: RESEARCH ALERT - Itausa begun as a buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Itausa begun as a buy.

text.p: ING Barings said in a report it had initiated coverage of Itausa, holding company for Brazilian private bank Banco Itau, with a buy rating on its preferred shares.

- Said the recommendation was "based on the 20 percent discount of Itausa's market value versus the combined market value of its parts, and the stocks' 38 percent under-performance versus the local index in the last three months."
- "We believe Itausa, the holding company, is the most attractive way to play Banco Itau," said analyst Nuno Fernandes in the report.
- Itau, Brazil's second largest private bank, represents approximately 90 percent of Itausa's revenues.
- also said Banco Itau's possible strategic acquisitions of other banks, starting with Rio de Janeiro state bank Banerj, would be positive to Itausa's long-term value.
- also said Itausa should improve its efficiencies by reducing costs and headcount at the bank.
- Itausa preferred was up 4.76 percent at 0.88 reais at 1620 local/1920 GMT on the Sao Paulo bolsa.
